macros.name: GetOpenaccessURLWrapped
macros.doc: Obtain the best open access URL as returned by the Unpaywall API wrapped in the \url macro.

macros.name: IsOpenaccess
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the DOI is an open access work according to the Unpaywall database and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: OpenaccessURLisDOI
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the best open access URL as returned by the Unpaywall API is the DOI and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: SetDOIAPICacheExpiration
macros.doc: Set the expiration period for the cache. If the information for an entry in the cache is older than ⟨days⟩ days it will be queried again.

macros.name: SetDOIAPIMail
macros.doc: Define the email address that is going to be used for API queries that require an email.
